zh-CN.title: 更清爽的广场
items: 居中频道与左右操作组成单行导航，广场使用纯色底色和更小的卡片圆角
图片卡片移除数量角标，活动卡片增加本空间参与者头像和人数
暂无参与者时展示加入邀请，互动额度和广场消息移至我的频道

en.title: A cleaner Square
items: Centered channels, search and publishing share one row above solid backgrounds and smaller card corners
Image counts are removed; activity cards show participant avatars and counts from your space
Empty activities invite you to join; quotas and Square notifications are available in My
